name: nebi-replies
description: Draws a reply's ✅ or ⏳ status line as a DONE or WORKING badge and hides one-line narration between tool calls.

notes.title: Notes between tool calls
notes.description: hide drops short narration like "Let me read the file." from steps that went on to call tools; status notes, heads-ups and deviation notes always show. show keeps every note. The final reply always shows.
